meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,遇到容器代理故障时,Claude 会按 debug 技能排查:检查日志、查询会话数据库、核对挂载配置,并对照常见问题清单给出诊断和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说东西不工作、容器失败、认证出错,或想了解容器系统如何运行时触发。Claude 会开始排查日志、数据库和挂载。

say.text: 容器刚启动就退出了,帮我查 nanoclaw.log 里的报错。
say.note: Claude 会检查容器退出原因和相关日志。

say.text: 怎么确认没有重复的 nanoclaw 服务实例?
say.note: Claude 会给出检查重复进程和停用旧服务的步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, when container agent issues occur, Claude follows this debug skill: checks logs, queries session DBs (inbound/outbound), verifies mounts, and offers diagnosis/fix steps from the common-issue checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you report things not working, container failures, authentication problems, or want to understand how the container system works. Claude begins checking logs, databases, and mounts.

say_en.text: The container exits right after starting; check nanoclaw.log for errors.
say_en.note: Claude investigates the exit cause and relevant logs.

say_en.text: This session's inbound.db has a message but outbound.db has no reply. Why?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the session DBs to locate the break.

say_en.text: How do I confirm there are no duplicate nanoclaw service instances?
say_en.note: Claude shows how to check processes and disable stale ones.
